integrity: Mathematical claims and computation limits are explicit; the proof is analytic and tests are reproducible. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete solution applies to one exceptional cross-edge conductance and unit weights on all other complete-bipartite edges, with p,q>=3 and independent vertex-coordinate inputs.
Exact controllability is algebraic; no conditioning or control-energy uniformity as the exceptional conductance approaches 1 is asserted.
Originality was assessed against identified published methods and relevant research records; independent verification and comprehensive unindexed-literature coverage are not claimed.
title: Exact actuator-set polynomials for a single-link defect in complete bipartite networks
